column3: MT 21:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; the present “rejoices” is rendered “will be glad.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his honor” is rendered “His glory,” and “Your victory” as “Your salvation.”
“You give him blessings” is rendered “You make him most blessed.”
“The time of your presence” is rendered “the time of your anger.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they extended evil” is rendered “they intended evil,” and NASB adds “Though.”
“You will make them a shoulder” is rendered “You will make them turn their back,” and “You will prepare on” as “You will aim with Your bowstrings at.”
